retrievalProfile.description: A dark, high-contrast layout featuring a centered metallic purple script title over a desaturated, ornate mandala-patterned background with heavy grit and grain.
triggerTerms: purple chrome script on dark background
gritty dark urban aesthetic with metallic text
excludeWhen: bright or colorful backgrounds are required
minimalist or clean vector styles are requested
sans-serif display typography is the primary focus

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered composition dominated by a vibrant, 3D-effect purple metallic script title. The background is a deep black with a subtle, large-scale grey mandala or paisley pattern, overlaid with white dust, scratches, and a radial light burst emanating from the center.
coreVisualRelationships: Vibrant purple title against a monochromatic dark background
Sharp, aggressive script angles contrasting with circular background patterns
Clean, small sans-serif metadata framing the large expressive title
Heavy texture and grain unifying the foreground and background elements
coreInvariants: High-gloss metallic purple texture on the main script
Desaturated, low-opacity ornate circular pattern in the background
Centralized vertical alignment for all text elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The main title is centrally located, spanning approximately 80% of the width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright purple metallic script acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the vibrant center title, move upward to the artist name, then downward to the production credits and bottom logos.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense but dark; the corners are heavily vignetted to keep focus on the center.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and charcoal grey background tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vivid electric purple for the primary title.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for secondary metadata and texture flecks.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast between the dark background and the bright, saturated purple highlights.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to black, white, grey, and shades of purple.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Aggressive, slanted script with sharp terminals
letterConstructionRules: Thick, gestural strokes with visible 3D beveling
Internal highlights mimicking liquid metal or silk texture
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'P' and 'R' feature elongated, sharp tails that anchor the word edges.

composition.overlap: letters tightly kerned with some overlap
composition.relationshipToImage: floats above background with drop shadow

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-energy custom script paired with minimalist, wide-tracked sans-serif for legibility.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the aggressive, sharp-edged energy of the title.
Approximates the clean, spaced-out metadata look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a dark charcoal background with a large, faint, grey ornate mandala pattern. Add a subtle radial light burst from the center and overlay with white dust and film grain textures.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, centered title in a sharp, metallic purple script with a 3D beveled effect. Place small, white, wide-tracked sans-serif text at the top and bottom center.

verificationChecks: Is the background dark with a faint ornate pattern?
Is the metadata text white and widely spaced?
Is there a visible grit/grain texture across the image?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the purple metallic sheen
Visibility of the background mandala pattern
Amount of dust and scratch texture
Tracking width of the metadata text
mustRedesign: Unique brand icons at the bottom

avoid: Flat, matte colors for the title

postGenerationChecks: Check that the purple script has a 3D/metallic feel.
Ensure the background pattern is subtle and doesn't distract from the text.
Verify the white metadata is legible against the dark background.
Confirm the presence of grit and grain overlays.
recipe.reuseFormula: Metallic script + Ornate dark pattern + Gritty texture + Wide-tracked sans-serif metadata = Dark Urban Trap Aesthetic
